Nice chicken wraps
Jan 2023
Popped in here during Tet as it was open and we had been meaning to go for a while. The inside is very well decorated and has a cool vibe to it.
Not sure if it was due to Tet that they seemed light on staff, when we went in we didn't see a member of staff for the first 10mins, but we were happy enough to find a table and grab a menu to browse through.
We both really enjoyed the chicken shawarma wraps, the had great flavour and were well filled. The side pitta bread and hummus was tasty, we were not too keen on the falafels though, they were a little on the dry side. They were out of vine leaves, so we will just have to go back and try them another time
The member of staff we had was a little cold and didn't make much effort to interact, but otherwise the food was tasty and good value so we enjoyed that

Top Shelf Egyptian Food
Jul 2020
Al Sultan serves some of the best Egyptian food we've ever had, and we lived in the Middle East and visited Egypt. We're willing to bet this is the best Egyptian food in Vietnam. If you know Egyptian and Middle Eastern food, just choose your favorites and enjoy. We like the koshari, falafel, and shawarma. What's even more fun about Al Sultan is all the football, Mo Salah, and ancient Egypt swag. Good times!
